Definition: an Arvadite or citizen of Arvad
BiblicalUsage: The Arvadite is named twice, in the table of nations and in the chronicler's copy of it, as one of the families of Canaan the son of Ham. The name marks a people of the coast, and the verse gives the family and nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: A coastal family counted among the sons of Canaan carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the record, that the peoples of the sea coast were known to God by name.
